name: jev
description: Jev decision engine for Codex: structured routing (Choice), risk checks (Noul), scoring, and a six-signal action guard, via a local MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Jev exposes the Jev decision engine to Codex through a local MCP server. Use it only when several execution paths are genuinely plausible, or when a risky action needs a structured second opinion.
defaultPrompt: Use Jev to compare these execution paths.
